dataset.reference_labels: Categories assigned by GPT Sol 6.1 under the frozen category policy; the quality baseline, not independently adjudicated human ground truth.

methodology: Each configuration uses a fresh in-process input/prefix cache and the same committed runtime. Persistent compiled GPU kernels are reused. One unrelated email warms the common guide/typed head before measurement. Four full passes: first serial, repeat serial, and two four-client passes. Labels never enter request payloads. Four clients are outstanding HTTP calls; actual GPU batches remain capped at two. Full and Flash use the same physical 400W 3090 sequentially. All original containers are restored. Flash/3090 received two additional four-client confirmation passes after a first-use batch spike; all passes are retained. The main warmed concurrency figure uses those last two confirmation passes.
